purpose: Evidence for the project owner to sign off, or not, on ten candidate events for Milestone 2 step 3 (batch 1 of 7, the first ~11 of 66 surviving step-3 candidates by filing date). Nothing here is an acceptance: each event stays quarantined, and no label is computed, until the corresponding attestations are added.
how_candidates_were_chosen: Batch 1 is the first 11 of the 66 frozen step-3 candidates by filing date (CACI 2025-01-22 through ASMB 2024-11-07 -- the pool itself spans 2024-11-01 through 2025-06-01 and is not sorted by date, so 'batch 1' is simply the first 11 rows worked through). One of the 11, CACI's 2025-04-24 Form 8-K/A, was excluded as a duplicate correction of the 2025-04-23 candidate (reports/m2-step3-eligibility-review-2026-10-01.json) -- the only 8-K/A among all 66 real candidates. The remaining 10 are built into config/m2-step3-events.json. All 66 had already passed the same-day-competing-catalyst policy (reports/m2-step3-same-day-catalyst-review-2026-10-01.json, supplemented below) and a real browser-fetched SEC cohort freeze (reports/m2-step3-sec-cohort-freeze.json) before any of these 10 were selected for this check.

dry_run.result: All 10 pending events ran with no attestations: every event quarantined on FIRST_PUBLIC_TIME_UNVERIFIED with no labels. All 10 showed all required sessions present, no zero-volume days, and an EMPTY real Alpaca corporate-actions response -- cleaner than step 2's own batch 1, which had one real dividend (CXT). No candidate in this batch needs its own corporate-actions exception.

signoff_items_requested.first_public_time_and_historical_identit: Accept the chronology and identity evidence per candidate below, including the residual gap that open-web search cannot close (a live or unrecorded earlier disclosure), and the one same-day finding below (PARR) assessed under docs/SAME-DAY-COMPETING-CATALYST-POLICY.md.
signoff_items_requested.corporate_actions: For all 10 candidates: accept two independent clean signals -- no Item 3.03/5.03 8-K on the event date itself in the shown history, and Alpaca's real, fully paginated corporate-actions response empty for the window. No exceptions in this batch.
